title: AI Trading Consultant
author: Hefty_Vermicelli_802
selftext:
I am testing a personal trading agent that helps identify emerging opportunities, allocate capital, and continuously improve investment decision-making. 

The goal is to save me time reading, studying and analyzing companies and stock; I will still do it on the side but I am trying to implement what I learned and what I am looking for into the agent. Also, I want to correct my tendency to be a reluctant seller.

The system is designed to seek asymmetric upside through a combination of growth compounders and emerging category leaders. It reflects my pretty aggressive / medium risk approach and conviction in a couple of high potential (to me) industries.

The goals of this post are:

* exchange ideas / lessons learned and insights with people who already built something similar
* share outcome of the model and brainstorm on the improvement
* evaluate performances and best approaches

I have a working MVP, that I am texting and improving but I am far from the final product I have in mind. The agent has been running for 2 weeks only so I don't have many data point on the performance yet.

I am happy to discuss details on the architecture, models I used, guidelines, etc.

  
*\*\*\*IMPORTANT: I don’t expect this to be a panacea or deliver crazy returns. The goal is to save me time, improve decision discipline, and correct my tendency to be a reluctant seller.\*\*\**
